title: Vladislav Ursu at the Olympic qualifying tournament!
excerpt: The mixed doubles Olympic qualifying tournament
body_html:
On 11-12 April, the Czech town of Havířov hosted the Olympic qualifying tournament for mixed doubles, with 26 pairs from various countries — including the best players in the world — competing for four places at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. Among them was a pair from Moldova, Alexandra Chiriakova and Vladislav Ursu, the latter an ATTP member. They earned the right to take part thanks to outstanding results throughout the 2021-2024 Olympic cycle, finishing near the top at national and European championships.


In their first match the Moldovan players faced a strong Czech pair, Jan Valenta and Zdena Blašková, who hold a higher world ranking. Even so, Alexandra and Vladislav won 4:2, showing a high level of preparation. In the next match they played a Spanish pair — Alvaro Robles and Maria Xiao, ranked 6th in the world. It was a tense match and, unfortunately, the Moldovan pair lost 2:4. In the last game they led 10:8 but could not close it out, losing 11:13.

From 6 to 12 May 2024, Sarajevo (Bosnia and Herzegovina) will host the European qualifying tournament, where the best players will compete for five Olympic places in singles — and our player, International Master of Sport Vladislav Ursu, will be taking part.
